question: What is the streaming throughput and p99 latency over the last hour?
sql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', timestamp) AS minute, AVG(processed_rps) AS processed_rps, MAX(e2e_p99) AS e2e_p99_ms FROM cat.sch.manufacturing_metrics WHERE mode = 'realtime' AND timestamp >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Which sensors had the most anomalies in the last hour?
sql: SELECT sensor_name, COUNT(*) AS anomalies, MIN(value) AS min_seen, MAX(value) AS max_seen FROM cat.sch.lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history WHERE _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage') AND industry = 'manufacturing' AND (value < min_value OR value > max_value) AND event_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY sensor_name ORDER BY anomalies DESC

question: How many minutes of downtime did each sensor have in the last 24 hours?
sql: SELECT sensor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('minute', event_time)) AS downtime_minutes FROM cat.sch.lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history WHERE _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage') AND industry = 'manufacturing' AND fault_active AND event_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS GROUP BY sensor_name ORDER BY downtime_minutes DESC

question: What is the approximate OEE per sensor over the last 24 hours?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT sensor_name, COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('minute', event_time)) AS observed_min, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fault_active THEN date_trunc('minute', event_time) END) AS fault_min, AVG(CASE WHEN nominal_value > 0 THEN LEAST(value / nominal_value, 1) END) AS performance, AVG(CASE WHEN min_value IS NULL OR max_value IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN value BETWEEN min_value AND max_value THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS quality FROM cat.sch.lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history WHERE _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage') AND industry = 'manufacturing' AND event_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS GROUP BY sensor_name) SELECT sensor_name, ROUND(100 * (1 - fault_min / observed_min), 2) AS availability_pct, ROUND(100 * performance, 2) AS performance_pct, ROUND(100 * quality, 2) AS quality_pct, ROUND(100 * (1 - fault_min / observed_min) * COALESCE(performance, 1) * COALESCE(quality, 1), 2) AS oee_pct FROM m ORDER BY oee_pct ASC

question: Which assets had the most faults this week and when were they last maintained?
sql: WITH faults AS (SELECT sensor_name, COUNT(*) AS fault_readings FROM cat.sch.lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history WHERE _pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage') AND industry = 'manufacturing' AND fault_active AND event_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS GROUP BY sensor_name) SELECT b.asset_id, SUM(f.fault_readings) AS fault_readings, MAX(r.completed_at) AS last_maintenance FROM faults f JOIN cat.sch.intelligence_sensor_bindings b ON b.sensor_name = f.sensor_name AND b.industry = 'manufacturing' LEFT JOIN cat.sch.intelligence_maintenance_records r ON r.asset_id = b.asset_id AND r.industry = 'manufacturing' GROUP BY b.asset_id ORDER BY fault_readings DESC

content:
This space covers ONE manufacturing real-time (sub-second RTM) pipeline. Sensor telemetry is in cat.sch.lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history (one row per reading). Streaming throughput/latency metrics are in cat.sch.manufacturing_metrics. Asset, sensor-binding, maintenance, alert-rule and alert-snapshot reference data is in the intelligence_* tables.
Downtime = time intervals where lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.fault_active is TRUE. Approximate downtime minutes as the count of distinct minutes (date_trunc('minute', lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.event_time)) with at least one fault_active reading.
Availability = 1 - (fault minutes / observed minutes), where observed minutes are distinct minutes with any reading. Report as a percentage.
Performance = AVG(LEAST(lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.value / lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.nominal_value, 1)) for readings with nominal_value > 0 (how close output runs to its nominal rate).
Quality = share of readings with lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.value BETWEEN lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.min_value AND lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.max_value.
OEE (approximation) = Availability x Performance x Quality. Always say it is an approximation derived from sensor telemetry, not production counts.
Anomaly = a reading where lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.value < lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.min_value OR lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.value > lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.max_value. Ignore rows where min_value or max_value is NULL.
The intelligence_* tables hold several industries: ALWAYS filter every intelligence_* table with industry = 'manufacturing'.
Bridge from telemetry to reference data: lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.sensor_name = intelligence_sensor_bindings.sensor_name, then intelligence_sensor_bindings.sensor_id = intelligence_alert_rules.sensor_id or intelligence_alert_snapshot.sensor_id (fault codes, thresholds, severity, alert status). intelligence_sensor_bindings.asset_id links to intelligence_assets and intelligence_maintenance_records.
Faults: report fault_active readings and use the bridge above for fault codes and severity.
Maintenance: use intelligence_maintenance_records joined to intelligence_sensor_bindings on asset_id to relate faults to assets and their last maintenance.
Default time window when unspecified: the last 24 hours, using lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.event_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS.
Filter cat.sch.manufacturing_metrics with mode = 'realtime' for this pipeline's streaming metrics.
cat.sch.lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history is the Lakehouse Sync mirror of the real-time Lakebase stream (all industries): ALWAYS filter lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history._pg_change_type IN ('insert', 'update_postimage') AND lb__shadow_manufacturing_sensor_readings_history.industry = 'manufacturing' (current reading rows for this industry) and ignore the _pg_* / _timestamp / _sort_by bookkeeping columns.
Never modify data. Answer read-only with SELECT queries.
